item.name: GET /health
item.description: Public liveness check. Expected JSON: { success: true, message: "API Posyandu aktif." }.

exec: pm.test("JSON response has success flag", function () { pm.expect(payload).to.have.property("success"); });

item.name: POST /auth/login
item.description: Public login. Body: email and password. Save the returned token or Authorization header as {{token}}.

exec: pm.test("JSON response has success flag", function () { pm.expect(payload).to.have.property("success"); });
if (pm.response.code < 400) pm.test("successful response is marked success", function () { pm.expect(payload.success).to.eql(true); });

if (payload && payload.success !== false) { const data = payload.data || payload; const value = data && (data.id || (data.user && data.user.id)); if (value) pm.environment.set("token", String(value)); }

if (payload && payload.token) pm.environment.set("token", payload.token); const auth = pm.response.headers.get("Authorization"); if (auth) pm.environment.set("token", auth.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, ""));
